_about: Every role in Rootline: tenant role templates, client roles and contact scopes, platform staff, partners and public visitors. Matrices are parsed verbatim from the specs named in each block.

_legend.grants: R read; W create/update; D delete/void/archive; X special action. Scope after '/': a all, b branch, c crew (visibility window), o own/assigned. '-' none; 'cfg' off by default, Company can enable; '<=lim' subject to approval limits (02 §5.6).
_legend.nav: F full, R read-mostly, '-' hidden, C Company-configurable (default in brackets).

roles.name: Business Owner
roles.summary: Everything, plus owner-only permissions (Stripe connection, bank accounts, roles, subscription, data export).

roles.name: Office / Admin Manager
roles.summary: Front office: CRM, scheduling, invoicing, collections, team admin (no role editing); no Ledger P&L by default.

roles.name: Sales Rep / Estimator
roles.summary: Own pipeline, Estimates and Proposals; cost and margin on own Estimates; branch lead pool.

roles.name: Landscape Designer
roles.summary: Design Studio, Mockups, Plant KB, prices (no cost or margin by default).

roles.name: Operations / Account Manager
roles.summary: Branch operations: Jobs, Visits, dispatch, Crews, equipment, timesheet approval, job cost (margin per setting), as-built publishing.

roles.name: Crew Lead / Foreman
roles.summary: Crew app: crew Visits, crew time edits, checklists, chemical logs, field change-order drafts, optional field payments.

roles.name: Field Technician / Crew Member
roles.summary: Crew app: own time, crew Visits (limited), photos, checklists. No prices, no client phone numbers by default.

roles.name: Bookkeeper / Accountant
roles.summary: Ledger, AR/AP, bank rec, reports, payroll export, read-only ops drill-down (billing fields only).
roles.seat: free (1 per Company; more via Accountant Partner)

roles.name: Subcontractor
roles.summary: Assigned subcontract orders only; bills to the Company. Never sees client pricing or other subs.
roles.mfa: required for the full sub portal; single-order links need none
roles.login: Magic link + SMS OTP; passkey for bills and banking

roles.name: Observer (starter custom role)
roles.summary: Read-only investor, silent partner or family member: dashboards and margin, no PII, no client-list exports.

roles.name: Residential Homeowner
roles.summary: Single-property, story-like portal: next step, proposals with mockups, schedule, pay, requests, visit reports.

roles.name: Commercial PM / HOA / Facilities
roles.summary: Multi-property workspace with approvals, POs, documents and proof-of-service reports.
roles.login: Magic link + passkey; SSO for large PM firms [V2]

roles.name: Primary contact
roles.summary: Full rights on the Client account. Exactly one per Client.

roles.name: Co-owner
roles.summary: View everything, approve Proposals, pay; payment methods configurable (default off).

roles.name: Approver
roles.summary: Review and vote on Proposals and change orders within an approval policy; rights lapse at term end.

roles.name: Billing contact
roles.summary: Invoices, statements, payments and tax certificates only.

roles.name: Property / site contact
roles.summary: Schedule, visit notices, requests and photos for assigned Properties only; never prices or invoices.

roles.name: Viewer
roles.summary: Read-only on shared Designs and Proposals (consultant, landscape architect, family member).

roles.name: Platform Operator / Super Admin (the founder)
roles.summary: Final authority on tenants, pricing, Plant KB policy, AI spend and security exceptions. Sees everything; never touches customer data without consent.

roles.name: Platform Support
roles.summary: Onboarding, migrations, consented read-only View as user, goodwill credits within limits, dunning recovery.

roles.name: Platform Curator (horticulturist)
roles.summary: Full write to the Plant KB and Regions; zero tenant business data.

roles.name: Platform Finance
roles.summary: Rootline's own SaaS billing, catalog drafts, refunds and credits, revenue recognition. No access to tenants' client payments by design.

roles.name: Platform Engineer
roles.summary: Infrastructure, flags, queues, logs with PII redaction. Production data only through just-in-time, approved break-glass.

roles.name: Partner admin (accountant firm, reseller, association)
roles.summary: Runs the partner firm: client list, referrals, commissions, certification, staff.

roles.name: Partner member (staff accountant)
roles.summary: Works client books through delegated access; no partner commissions.

roles.name: Prospect (landscape business owner)
roles.summary: Evaluates Rootline on the marketing site: tours, pricing, switch guides, trial and demo.

roles.name: Homeowner (Rootline Home)
roles.summary: Anonymous until they save: address or photo to concepts, plant list and budget, then a matched pro.

footnotes: Anti-escalation applies: users can assign only roles whose grants are less than or equal to their own; ops_manager can assign field roles in their branch.
